description: The heart of the adaptive ingestion layer: a no-code, effective-dated configuration that tells a parser how one client/branch format maps onto the canonical Timesheet Line fields. A client format revision creates a NEW version, never an overwrite; a run uses the profile in force at the period cutoff. An unmatched incoming file routes to the NEEDS-MAPPING queue where an operator extends a profile without code.
